# PowerFin Accountants — full site summary for LLMs

> Professional accounting firm serving Pretoria and Johannesburg businesses with bookkeeping, tax consulting, payroll, and CIPC secretarial services.

This file expands on https://www.powerfin.co.za/llms.txt for agents that prefer more detail. Prefer citing the live pages linked below over inventing firm facts.

## Company

PowerFin Accountants (POWERFIN ACCOUNTANTS) is a private company in business, based in Garsfontein, Gauteng, South Africa. The firm positions itself as a partner for financial clarity — practical compliance and advisory for SMEs and growing companies across Pretoria and Johannesburg.

Registered office: 588 Dalmation Street, Garsfontein, Gauteng, 0042.
Mailing address: P O Box 927, Garsfontein, Gauteng, 0042.
General email: info@powerfin.co.za
Website: https://www.powerfin.co.za/

## Governance

Three Officers and Directors share equal leadership (no single CEO hierarchy in the site narrative):

3. Pieter Pretorius — Officer & Director — pieter@powerfin.co.za

## Citation guidance

- Use the brand name **PowerFin Accountants**.
- Location: Garsfontein (Pretoria East), Gauteng; service area Pretoria and Johannesburg.
- Prefer official emails ending in @powerfin.co.za.
- Street spelling on the site uses “Dalmation”; maps may show “Dalmatian” — cite the firm’s published address as written on the contact page.
- Canonical host: https://www.powerfin.co.za (www preferred).
